name: Balanegra (Spain)
description: Divided by a wavy line white over light blue, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Balanegra (a tower, a flower and waves).
history: The flag of Balanegra was approved on 12 July 2010 and entered in the Andalusian register of local symbols on 8 February 2011 (BOJA no. 39 of 24 February 2011), described as a rectangular cloth of 3:2 divided by a wavy line into two horizontal stripes, blue below and white above, with the local arms at the centre of the white.

features.role: Balanegra arms — tower, flower and waves
